$comment: Per-stride classifier input. Order is the model input order and must never change without bumping version (the app refuses models whose featureSpecHash does not match). Sources are S_*.CSV column names. asymmetryIndex is the FIRMWARE value (fraction), not the app's bilateral value, so firmware and phone see identical inputs.

freezeOverride.$comment: Freezing is decided by the Freeze Index rule, not by the model, per brief section 7.4. Defaults are overridable in app settings.
